subject: Renewal negotiation: Gridline expansion — proposed credits & conditional price hold
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@gridline.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@gridline.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — we need price predictability for expansion

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the initial renewal note. Quick context: Gridline is moving three new teams into production next quarter which will materially raise our monthly token consumption. We like Redwood's performance but we need predictable unit economics across the next 12 months while we scale.

Specifically: can we get a 12-month price hold or a staged commit with credits that covers an expected 40% spike in usage for the first two quarters? Procurement will also need a simple addendum for our legal team.

Attached a short usage extract (Q1) to help you model. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call next week.

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Platform, Gridline AI

Attachments: Gridline_Q1_usage_report.csv (csv, 42KB)
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@gridline.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — we need price predictability for expansion

Hi Alice — really appreciate the data, and congrats on the upcoming rollout.

High-level options (quick):
1) Conditional 12-mo price hold: lock current per-token rate for 12 months if Gridline commits to a 20% minimum monthly commit (with a true-up at year-end).
2) Staged commit + bridge credits: a two-quarter surge credit (applied as pre-paid token credits) that covers ~35-45% of the projected spike, then re-evaluate for the back half of the year.
3) Volume discount ladder: tiered discounts kicking in as run-rate crosses thresholds (helps if the spike is sustained).

I can draft a short term-sheet showing numbers for options 1 and 2 and loop in Finance for approvals. Would Thursday 10am PT work for a 30-min call to run the numbers?

Best,
Neha
Enterprise Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Gridline renewal — ask for price hold + credits (internal thread)

Marissa / Ben / Monica — forwarding Gridline's ask. Key asks: price hold for 12 months OR staged commit with bridge credits to cover ~40% spike. They are planning three product teams in Q3.

What I need:
- Marissa: approval for up to a 15% effective concession (credits + discount blended) on a 12-month term OR approval to offer a short bridge-credit package (~$75k-125k range) to cover the first two quarters.
- Ben: can you run the model for both options (impact to ARR, blended unit economics, payback window)?
- Monica: if we do the credit + staged commit path, operations will need an onboarding playbook for burst capacity — can your team confirm feasibility?

I proposed a Thurs 10am PT call; please flag if you can't join.

Thanks,
Neha
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Gridline renewal — ask for price hold + credits (internal thread)

Neha — quick guidance from me:
- Approve the conditional 12-mo price hold if the commit floor is >=20% of their current run-rate and the term includes a year-end true-up. That mitigates long tail risk.
- Approve bridge-credit offer up to $100k (applied as token credits over Q3/Q4) if Ben's model shows acceptable payback (<9 months) and Ops confirms burst onboarding.

Please include SLA/Regional-fallback language in the term-sheet. Also, insist on a single signature addendum (no multi-stage legal review) — attach a short 1-page addendum.

Marissa
VP, Renewals & GTM Partnerships
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gridline renewal — ask for price hold + credits (internal thread)

Team — ran the numbers with the usage extract. Two quick models attached in my head:
- Option A (20% commit + 12-mo price hold): incremental net-new ARR impact ~ -$125k for year 1, payback ~8 months after expansion stabilizes.
- Option B (No price hold + $100k bridge credits): AR uplift is better in year 1 but we see volatility risk if usage drops; net effect ~ -$75k in year 1 but faster recovered run-rate.

If Ops signs off on burst readiness I'd prefer Option B (bridge credits) — lower long-term revenue dilution and faster recovery. If they need legal simplicity, Option A (conditional price hold) is clean.

I'll attach a short spreadsheet to the HubSpot record.

Ben
Finance, Commercial Deals
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@gridline.ai>
Cc: procurement@gridline.ai, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Gridline term-sheet (two options) — draft attached

Hi Alice — thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion, attaching a short term-sheet with two paths:
1) Conditional 12-month price hold (requires 20% minimum commit; year-end true-up).
2) Short bridge-credit package ($100k of pre-paid token credits applied across Q3/Q4) + staged commit and a follow-up re-evaluation at month 9.

We also included a one-page addendum for signature to keep legal turnaround time short. Marissa and Ben are copied in for operational and finance alignment.

Please review and let me know which option Gridline prefers; we can finalize a simple addendum and route for signature.

Best,
Neha
Attachments: Gridline_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@gridline.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@gridline.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gridline term-sheet (two options) — draft attached

Neha — thanks, and appreciate the speed. Gridline prefers Option 2 (bridge-credit package + staged commit). Procurement will sign the 1-page addendum once we confirm the exact credit allocation schedule.

Can you confirm credits will be applied automatically to overage invoices and that credits expire end of Q4 2027? If so, we are ready to proceed and will route for signature.

Alice
